description: This file defines a caching system for the LiteLLM project, including various cache classes, cache management functions, and cache configuration utilities. It handles different cache backends such as Redis, S3, GCS, Azure Blob, in-memory, disk, and Qdrant, and provides methods for cache key generation, cache retrieval, and cache updating.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: A class managing different cache backends for LiteLLM, providing methods for cache key generation, retrieval, and storage, supporting multiple cache types such as Redis, S3, GCS, Azure Blob, in-memory, disk, and Qdrant.

classes.name: CacheMode
classes.description: An enumeration for cache modes, either 'default_on' or 'default_off', controlling cache usage behavior.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Cache object with specified backend type and configuration parameters, setting up the appropriate cache backend instance.

methods.name: get_cache_key
methods.description: Generates a cache key based on provided arguments, including optional preset keys, parameter values, and namespace handling.

methods.name: _get_param_value
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific parameter from kwargs, with special handling for 'model' and 'file' parameters.

methods.name: _get_model_param_value
methods.description: Determines the model parameter value, considering caching groups and model groups for routing.

methods.name: _get_caching_group
methods.description: Checks metadata for caching groups and returns the appropriate group if the model belongs to one.

methods.name: _get_file_param_value
methods.description: Retrieves the file identifier from kwargs, used for transcription requests.

methods.name: _get_preset_cache_key_from_kwargs
methods.description: Extracts a preset cache key from kwargs if available, to avoid recomputing cache keys.

methods.name: _set_preset_cache_key_in_kwargs
methods.description: Stores the computed cache key into kwargs to prevent duplicate computation.

methods.name: _get_hashed_cache_key
methods.description: Creates a SHA-256 hash of the cache key string for secure and consistent key storage.

methods.name: _add_namespace_to_cache_key
methods.description: Prefixes the cache key with a namespace if provided, for multi-tenant or scoped caching.

methods.name: generate_streaming_content
methods.description: Yields content in chunks for streaming responses, with delays between chunks.

methods.name: _get_cache_logic
methods.description: Processes cached results, checking for expiration based on max_age, and returns the valid cached response.

methods.name: get_cache
methods.description: Retrieves a cached response based on cache key and arguments, supporting both sync and async contexts.

methods.name: async_get_cache
methods.description: Asynchronous version of get_cache for embedding and other async calls.

methods.name: _add_cache_logic
methods.description: Prepares cache data for storage, including timestamping and TTL handling.

methods.name: add_cache
methods.description: Stores a result in the cache with generated cache key and metadata.

methods.name: async_add_cache
methods.description: Asynchronous version of add_cache, supporting batch cache writes for high throughput.

methods.name: _convert_to_cached_embedding
methods.description: Converts various embedding response formats into a standardized CachedEmbedding dictionary.

methods.name: add_embedding_response_to_cache
methods.description: Adds an embedding response to cache, generating the cache key and converting the response.

methods.name: async_add_cache_pipeline
methods.description: Performs bulk cache writing for embedding responses asynchronously.

methods.name: should_use_cache
methods.description: Determines whether caching should be used based on mode and user options.

methods.name: batch_cache_write
methods.description: Performs batch cache write asynchronously.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Checks connectivity with the cache backend.

methods.name: delete_cache_keys
methods.description: Deletes specified cache keys asynchronously.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the cache backend if supported.

methods.name: _supports_async
methods.description: Indicates that all cache types support asynchronous operations.
